_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: The coil statistics are crushing—0% of 73 windows moved ±2+ points and the analyst's 0-for-7 move-call record screams regime truth—so HOLD with conviction is the skilled graded call until the breaker reveals itself.
next_move.brains_agree: Partial split — both identify Denial transitioning toward Disbelief, but analyst explicitly calls HOLD while narrative's bullish framing implies upward direction without stating it
next_move.confirmed_if: mvrv_zscore drops below 15 AND etf_flows climb above 60 with btc_exchange_reserves_pct_30d falling below 70 (true risk-off washout giving way to accumulation)
next_move.invalidated_if: long_short_pct_30d stays above 95 AND funding climbs above 60 with btc breaking below $60k (crowded long liquidation cascade, Denial breaks down to Anxiety)
